title: CityClimate Board
description: CityClimate Board is a tangible interface for real-time Local Climate Zone (LCZ) analysis. This repository accompanies the paper "Integration of a Conversational Large Language Model into a Portable Physical City Model to Support Participatory Climate-Related Urban Planning".
